m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Knight Errant, you seek to reclaim the Shrine to Nobility? The Shrine's Sacred Shield was ripped away by the Ogre Eurgh.
Eurgh dwells in the Froudling Village. Recover the shield and have it repainted before you return it to the Shrine.
My name is Eurgh! One punch and your face will be broken. I'll leave you split wide open!
I lost to a skinny Wizard!? In the old days, I would have killed 'em.
<ITALICS>You find the Shrine's Sacred Shield amongst the Ogre's collected treasures. </ITALICS>
You need my help to touch up a relic from the Shrine to Nobility? I'd be honored! Let's see what I can do...
<ITALICS>Ashlynn mixes a batch of paints and gets to work. It's amazing what a talented artist can do, seemingly effortlessly. </ITALICS>
There you go. What do you think? You should be able to ease it back into its spot on the Shrine.
<ITALICS>It's been pretty badly banged up. You should take it to the Master Arms Painter, Ashlynn Brushtail, to clean it. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>That looks great! A proper Shrine to Nobility of Kings and Knights and Common People Like You! </ITALICS>
You have restored the Shrine to Nobility! Well done! It is not enough to raise your status, but it shows your dedication!
I can tell you have visited several of the Knightly Shrines.
The Shrine to Nobility of Kings and Knights and Common People Like You is in disrepair.
Speak to Brigid in the Burial Ground and find out how to repair the Shrine to Nobility. Return here when it is restored!
The Shrine to Nobility in the Wyrd has fallen into disrepair. Ask Brigid how to restore it. Once the task is done, return to me.
